label: Defend the explanatory-ground bridge and adequacy of non-inherent asymmetric dependence
locator: I.9, 991a8–19; compare Plato Phaedo 100d–e and Timaeus 28a–b
goal: Defend the explanatory-ground bridge and adequacy of non-inherent asymmetric dependence. The finite ranked witness does not explain why a particular is F, efficient change, lawlike behavior or the maker/model relation. Determine whether the universal inherence requirement is defensible; do not identify efficient causation with static grounding.
reason: Issue #259 leaves the exact philosophical costs explicit after its objection/reply tests. These are research obligations, not unimplemented formal gates or authority from a finite model. The non-inherent grounding reply and the stronger adequacy requirement are discussed in docs/parmenides-participation-challenges.md#what-stays-unresolved.
